statement: Lewin's 2022 review describes 3D Riesz crystalline phases as numerically expected at low positive temperature; its Theorem 46 proves uniqueness only in the short-range low-activity region, so it does not establish P0309.
assumptions: This is a dated source assessment, not a current openness certificate
source: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2202.09240, PDF lines 6724-6740 and 7322-7345; math-brain P0309 card claim_894df26aac73717c54f790f08423c9c5e20c7eeea63ca049b11cab1e5c280c09
source_quote: For larger values of Υ, it is believed to form a solid.
proof_or_counterexample: Compare s>d and small activity in Theorem 46 with the proposed low-temperature crystal regime; theorem conclusion is a unique isometry-invariant fluid.
independent_reviewer: w542 pending for any new result; source check by w539
remaining_gap: An exact P0309 exponent, ensemble and order parameter and current status still need identification.

statement: For s>0 and x!=0 in R^3, the transverse Hessian eigenvalues of |x|^{-s} are -s|x|^{-s-2}.
source: w538/ATTEMPT.md O1; independently differentiated by w539
proof_or_counterexample: Writing r=|x| and e=x/r gives Hessian s r^{-s-2}((s+2)ee^T-I). Along x(t)=(1,t,0), second derivative of (1+t^2)^(-s/2) at t=0 is -s.
remaining_gap: Does not determine sign of collective lattice Hessian or Gibbs phase.

statement: If a finite labeled displacement Gibbs Hamiltonian H_D is even, C^2 and satisfies D^2H_D(u) >= kappa(L_D tensor I_3) for every u, then Re E B_{D,G} >= 1-|G|^2 C_3/(2 beta kappa), and E|B_{D,G}|^2 >= a^2 when a=1-|G|^2 C_3/(2 beta kappa)>0.
assumptions: D finite nonempty subset of Z^3
source: w538/ATTEMPT.md B1; arXiv:2405.06616 Theorem 3.13 p.19; independent algebra by w539
proof_or_counterexample: Apply Brascamp-Lieb with V=beta H_D and Gamma=beta kappa(L_D tensor I_3), then bound the diagonal of L_D^{-1} by the infinite-volume Green integral C_3; evenness centers u_x; cos t>=1-t^2/2 and Jensen yield the two bounds.
remaining_gap: Actual Riesz Gibbs Hamiltonian has no established global Hessian comparison, labeling, defect control or DLR limit; no parent-problem proof.

statement: For n>=2, s>0, a 3D n-particle Riesz pair Hamiltonian plus a C^2 perturbation with bounded Hessian near a two-particle collision has Hessian quadratic form along a relative transverse displacement equal to -4s epsilon^(-s-2)+O(1); therefore no fixed uniform positive-definite Hessian lower bound is possible on the full collision-free configuration space.
assumptions: two particles may approach at an interior point
proof_or_counterexample: Take separation epsilon e1, transverse velocities e2 and -e2; second derivative of (epsilon^2+4t^2)^(-s/2) at t=0 is -4s epsilon^(-s-2); all other terms contribute O(1).
independent_reviewer: w542 requested via review packet; pending
remaining_gap: Independent audit pending. This only refutes global convexity transfer; it does not prove or disprove P0309.

statement: Under a uniform Hessian/covariance bound without a coherent mean phase, a specified reciprocal Fourier mode can have E B=0 and E|B|^2 tending to zero in a family of even-sized nonadjacent Dirichlet site sets.
assumptions: D consists of N even nonadjacent sites in Z^3, so L_D=6I
H_D=3kappa sum_x |u_x-m_x|^2 with m_x=0 on half and e1/2 on half
source: w538/ATTEMPT.md O2; independent Gaussian calculation by w539
proof_or_counterexample: Each u_x is N(m_x,I/(6 beta kappa)); E exp(iG.u_x)=exp(-|G|^2/(12 beta kappa)) times +1 or -1. Thus E B=0. Independence gives E|B|^2=[1-exp(-|G|^2/(6 beta kappa))]/N. The Hessian equals kappa L_D tensor I_3.
remaining_gap: This refutes only a centering-free implication for the specified mode; it says nothing about all modes or P0309.

statement: For finite N>=2 and s>0, a 3D Riesz pair energy plus a locally C^2 external/background contribution has negative Hessian directions on an open set of near-collision configurations; a uniform positive-definite global Hessian lower bound is impossible on the full collision-free configuration space.
assumptions: two particles approach an interior point
source: w538/ATTEMPT.md O3; independently rederived by w539 ATTEMPT.md O2
proof_or_counterexample: For x1=0 and x2(t)=(epsilon,t,0), the close pair gives second derivative -s epsilon^(-s-2); all other terms are O(1). Continuity preserves negativity in a neighborhood for sufficiently small epsilon. The w539 two-particle relative path gives the same conclusion with factor -4s.
remaining_gap: A locally convex conditioned tube or nonconvex inequality might still work; full-law probability cost and DLR limit remain unproved.

statement: A circular full law whose ordered branch has probability exp(-cN) can have conditional Bragg second moment a^2 while its full pressure has zero right slope at h=0.
assumptions: S_N=aN exp(iTheta) with probability exp(-cN), Theta uniform
source: w538/PAIRED_AUDIT.md O4; independent log-sum-exp check by w539
proof_or_counterexample: The full second moment is a^2 exp(-cN). The angular integral of exp(beta h aN cos Theta) has exponential rate beta a|h|; hence p(h)=max(a|h|-c/beta,0), flat near zero.
remaining_gap: Only selected-branch substitution is refuted; C5 remains valid for its full-law premise, and no Riesz phase conclusion follows.
